content:
# 10 Python Tips for ADHD Developers

Writing code when your brain works differently isn't a bug — it's a feature waiting to be optimised.

## 1. Use meaningful variable names

Short cryptic names are an ADHD trap. `user_email` beats `ue` every time. Your future self will thank you.

## 2. Break tasks into 25-minute blocks

The Pomodoro technique pairs beautifully with Python development. Each pomodoro = one function or one test.

## 3. Auto-format your code

Install Black and stop arguing with yourself about formatting. One less decision to make.

## 4. Write tests first

Test-driven development gives your brain a clear target. Green light = dopamine hit.

## 5. Use type hints

Type hints are documentation that your editor actually reads. They reduce cognitive load significantly.

# The Science of Morning Routines

Neuroscience has a lot to say about why your morning sets the tone for everything that follows.

## The cortisol awakening response

In the first 30–45 minutes after waking, cortisol spikes sharply. This is your brain's natural alertness boost.

## Why checking your phone first is harmful

Immediate screen exposure floods your just-woken brain with notifications before your prefrontal cortex is fully online.

## Light exposure matters most

Natural light within 30 minutes of waking calibrates your circadian rhythm and improves sleep quality that night.

## The 3-intention method

Write three intentions — not tasks — before anything else. Intentions orient attention, tasks just fill time.

## Movement as a mood regulator

Even 10 minutes of walking raises BDNF, the protein responsible for neuroplasticity and mood regulation.

title: Building REST APIs with FastAPI
content:
# Building REST APIs with FastAPI

FastAPI has quietly become one of the best choices for Python API development.

## Why FastAPI wins

Automatic OpenAPI documentation, Pydantic validation, async support out of the box, and performance that rivals Go.

## Your first endpoint

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

@app.get('/items/{item_id}')
async def read_item(item_id: int):
    return {'item_id': item_id}
```

## Dependency injection

FastAPI's dependency system is elegant — inject databases, auth, and config without global state.

## Request validation

Pydantic models handle all validation automatically. Bad data never reaches your business logic.

## Deployment

Uvicorn + Gunicorn + Docker is the production-standard stack.
